messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: billing-telemetry anomaly detected for emitter-proxy (service=billing-emitter). sudden burst of usage flags and duplicate token counts. auto-pager -> #incidents.
laura_ops: seeing the same in dashboards, shadow tally diverging vs ledger. spike started ~1745056500.
jon_oncall: I'm on it. taking lead. any customer-facing alerts yet?
sam_sre: nothing from infra side (no pod OOMs), but redis write latency spiked at the time window. checking consumer lag.
mike_billing: got a couple support pings about overage emails — 2 customers so far, both small accounts. not system-wide yet.
anya_product: flagged by alerts, one of the affected customers is on Dedicated — high priority.
jon_oncall: ok triage plan: 1) pause outgoing billing notifications 2) isolate emitter-proxy writes to a safe store (dup filter) 3) start live reconcile job for last 1h.
laura_ops: +1 to pause notifications. patching notification lambda to a dry-run mode.
mike_billing: pushing dry-run now. will confirm when email gateway off.
incident-bot: Action: notification-service set to dry-run by mike_billing @ 1745056912.
sam_sre: attaching quick logs, looks like emitter produced duplicate batches after retry storm:
```
2024-06-01T12:01:02Z emitter-proxy INFO emit_count=1023 request_id=abc123
2024-06-01T12:01:03Z emitter-proxy INFO emit_count=1023 request_id=abc123 retry=1
2024-06-01T12:01:04Z emitter-proxy INFO emit_count=2046 request_id=def456
```
jon_oncall: that pattern => ack-loss + client retry loop. redis ACKs delayed ~300ms causing duplicates. recommended mitigations: client-side idempotency (short term: dedupe at ingest) + raise redis client timeout.
laura_ops: spinning up a dedupe sidecar for ingest path now (k8s rollout). patch is small, will route to dedupe queue.
mike_billing: email dry-run confirmed off. no more outbound messages. reply_all to support with update.
anya_product: customer comms draft: "We've temporarily paused billing emails while we investigate unexpected usage counts. We're working to reconcile counts and will notify affected customers within 2 hours." ok?
jon_oncall: fine. next: live recon job id=r-1745056930 started by laura_ops. it will compare raw emitter events -> ledger and emit corrective patch if needed.
laura_ops: recon job started, progress: scanning 3/12 shards, reconciled 42 accounts so far.
sam_sre: grabbed heap/profile from emitter-proxy — no memory leaks. redis cluster had a GC pause during the spike window (node-3). raising redis client timeout to 1s now.
jon_oncall: estimate: mitigation (dedupe + redis timeout) should stop new duplicates in ~5m after rolling update.
mike_billing: support update posted. two affected customers have been notified about investigation (no charge changes yet).
incident-bot: NOTE: notification-service dry-run active, dedupe-sidecar rollout in progress.
laura_ops: dedupe rollout complete on 4/4 pods @ 1745057420. tailing emitter metrics.
sam_sre: new metrics show emit_rate normalized, duplicate-rate dropped 95%.
anya_product: QA on reconciled accounts looks good — counts match pre-spike expected range for sampled accounts.
jon_oncall: ok, start backfill reconcile run for full window 1745056400-1745057600. laura_ops kick it off.
laura_ops: backfill started. note: we will mark any corrective credits as audit-only until finance ok's them.
mike_billing: looping in finance for credit policy. small customers likely auto-credit, enterprise handled case-by-case.
jon_oncall: monitoring for customer-visible overages, if none in next 30m we can mark incident as mitigated and move to postmortem.
incident-bot: Mitigation observed @ 1745059000: duplicate rate stable, notification dry-run still active.
laura_ops: backfill finished @ 1745059840: 128 accounts had inflated usage, total ~2.3M token delta. applied corrections to staging ledger, pushing final reconcile to prod after finance confirmation.
mike_billing: finance approved auto-credits for accounts with delta < $50. applying credits and scheduling emails (but still dry-run until we flip notifications).
anya_product: recommend postmortem items: 1) stronger idempotency keys 2) emitter retry backoff tuning 3) redis alarm on gc pauses 4) automations for notification dry-run.
jon_oncall: agreed. thank you team. I'll keep this thread open for final prod reconcile and postmortem notes. moving to status: mitigated -> monitoring. :white_check_mark:
laura_ops: leaving note: root cause = transient redis GC pause + aggressive client retry loop -> duplicate emit bursts -> billing counting drift.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated. final action items assigned. incident channel to remain open for 2 business days for postmortem comments.
mike_billing: closing support escalations as "investigating" -> will update customers with credit confirmations.
anya_product: adding postmortem owner: laura_ops. target doc by 2024-06-03.
jon_oncall: thanks all. short followup: please paste any missed logs here and I'll aggregate for the postmortem.
laura_ops: pasted final reconciled ledger diff files to /shared/incidents/1745056789/reconcile-diff.csv
sam_sre: leaving runbook note: temporary fix = increase redis client timeout + ingest dedupe; long term = idempotency tokens and better retry jitter.
incident-bot: thread archived for now but will reopen on comments."
